data.name: Beneath the Floor
data.detailed_description:
Beneath the Floor is a first-person exploration and automation game set beneath the surface of a quiet, forgotten place.
Dig deeper, uncover hidden systems, and slowly piece together a mysterious story buried underground.
What begins as simple exploration turns into something far more complex as machines awaken, systems connect, and the past reveals itself layer by layer.

Beneath the Floor is not about rushing forward.
It’s about curiosity, atmosphere, and discovery.
The deeper you go, the stranger things become — abandoned technology, forgotten experiments, and clues that suggest this place was never meant to be found.

Features:

  • First-person exploration focused on atmosphere and discovery

  • Dig, unlock, and expand underground areas

  • Automation systems that grow more complex over time

  • Light resource management and progression

  • Environmental storytelling told through space, machines, and systems

  • A calm but unsettling mood that rewards slow, thoughtful play

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
